pageProps.title: Towards Zero
pageProps.review: Agatha Christie's Towards Zero, which stands out for its sophisticated tricks and psychological depiction, is a masterpiece that depicts a murder case not as the beginning of the story but as the destination where all conflicts converge, providing a twist of the true culprit and a shocking conclusion.
pageProps.description: Within the time that is gradually tightening
pageProps.content:
## Review A work where the twist of the true culprit and the real mastermind behind it bring a shocking conclusion. A sophisticated trick that deceives the reader twice with multi-layered tricks and twists. This is indeed the ```Queen of Crime```.
The psychological depiction that well expresses the darkness within human nature also stands out.
The original title is also Towards Zero, seemingly because it views a murder case as the ```destination``` rather than the ```beginning``` of the story. In other words, from the perspective of this novel, a murder case is not a sudden accident, but a result where the pasts, desires, conflicts, and plans of various characters who seemed unrelated to each other flow and converge toward a single peak of ```murder```, namely **'Zero Hour'**, just as multiple rivers gather into one sea.
It was a work where one can see the true worth of Agatha Christie.
